record.original_question: Is every division algebra split by an abelian Galois extension of its center, and for specific ground fields can one bound the degree of such an abelian splitting field?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.5. Determine whether every division algebra is split by an abelian group, and find degree bounds over specific fields.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D$ be a finite-dimensional division algebra with center $F$ (so $D$ is a central division $F$-algebra of degree $n$, meaning $\dim_F D = n^2$). A field extension $L/F$ is called a splitting field of $D$ if $D \otimes_F L \cong M_n(L)$. The extension $L/F$ is called an abelian Galois extension if it is Galois with abelian Galois group $\mathrm{Gal}(L/F)$.

(a) Does every central division algebra $D$ over an arbitrary field $F$ admit a splitting field $L/F$ that is a finite abelian Galois extension of $F$?

(b) For specific classes of ground fields $F$ (for example, global fields, local fields, or function fields of curves over such fields), determine explicit upper bounds, in terms of the degree (or index, or exponent) of $D$, on the smallest degree $[L:F]$ of an abelian Galois splitting field $L$ of $D$, when such a splitting field exists.
artifact.category_tag: central simple algebras and Brauer group
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether every central division algebra is split by an abelian Galois extension of its center, together with the search for degree bounds over specific ground fields, is listed as an open problem in surveys of open questions on central simple algebras. No general resolution appears in the literature; partial results exist for specific fields (e.g., local and global fields where cyclic splittings exist by class field theory), but the general problem and sharp degree bounds remain open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on Central Simple Algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 2.5. Determine whether every division algebra is split by an abelian group, and find degree bounds over specific fields.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly stated as an open problem in a survey of open problems on central simple algebras.

status_evidence.title: Patching subfields of division algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Results on which finite groups appear as Galois groups of maximal subfields of division algebras over function fields.
status_evidence.claim: Related work addresses splitting/admissibility questions for division algebras but does not resolve the general abelian-splitting question.
